input.free_text_description: This system is a user management platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for user, user bean. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include microservices functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
